authority.scope: Private GTK2 stepper cache invalidation and regression only. No installed theme changes.

environment.engine: private R538 GtkStyle engine prototype derived from R536
environment.palette_fixture: Synthetic RC colors isolate the redraw mechanism; KDE roles and palette changes are not tested.

findings.stale_cache_reproduced: After gtk_widget_reset_rc_styles() changes GtkScrollbar::has-forward-stepper to false and GTK's internal has_stepper_d to false, the R536 control still paints the old right-stepper cache at its former cell.
findings.style_and_allocation_invalidation: R538 invalidates cached cells on GtkWidget style-set and size-allocate. With the same removal probe, its old 15x15 cell differs 207/225 pixels from the previously visible stepper, while a 1x1 partial damage/repaint returns to the post-removal baseline at 0/225 differences.
findings.regression: Four directions match fixture assets in normal, hover, pressed, released, endpoint and globally insensitive captures. Each pressed cell is restored after one-pixel damage. Input probe passes 8/8 movement, endpoint-blocking and whole-widget-insensitive cases.
findings.asset_failure: After-expose clears a cached cell when its saved asset cannot be loaded; this failure path was not exercised.

limits: Private GTK2 evidence only; no fresh Domain/OS SR10.4/HP VUE comparison or user visual review.
Synthetic fixed-color RC does not validate KDE semantic roles, color scheme changes or contrast.
Missing-asset fallback is coded but untested.
Only the common one-back/one-forward layout is covered; secondary steppers with duplicate directions remain untested and the cache still has one cell per direction.
PNG/GC I/O performance and broader style/palette transitions remain unmeasured.
No installation, personal application, VM or desktop was changed.
next: Review the private style-removal fix, test missing-asset fallback and duplicate-direction layouts, then compare GTK2 rendering against the project-owned SR10.4/HP VUE 2.01 VM before considering any user-profile integration.
